paramHints.container_name: Docker container name; empty follows the default (derived from the model name)
paramHints.host_port: Host port for the OpenAI-compatible API (/v1); changes take effect after a container restart
paramHints.image: llama.cpp server image (with tag), e.g. ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda
paramHints.gpu: GPU passthrough: all = every GPU, none = CPU only, device = specific IDs (e.g. device=0,1)
paramHints.gpu_layers: Layers offloaded to GPU: 0 = CPU only, >= total layers = full offload. Lower it when VRAM runs out
paramHints.ctx_size: Context window in tokens: larger fits longer conversations, KV-cache VRAM grows with it
paramHints.cache_type_k: K-cache quantization: f16 fastest/largest, q8_0 balanced, q4_0 most compact (slight quality loss)
paramHints.cache_type_v: V-cache quantization: only effective with Flash Attention on; usually benefits less than the K cache
paramHints.flash_attention: FlashAttention speeds up attention and lowers VRAM peaks; a few older GPUs/quant combos may not support it
paramHints.enable_thinking: Reasoning-chain toggle for thinking models (Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1); off saves many output tokens
paramHints.temp: Sampling temperature: higher is more diverse, lower more deterministic; near 0 approximates greedy decoding
paramHints.top_p: Nucleus sampling: draws only from candidates within cumulative probability p; complements temperature
paramHints.top_k: Considers only the top-k probable tokens per step; 0 = unlimited
paramHints.min_p: Drops candidates below (top probability x min_p); pairs well with higher temperatures
paramHints.repeat_penalty: Penalizes repetition; too high makes wording incoherent
paramHints.presence_penalty: Penalizes by the variety of already-seen tokens; encourages new topics

paramPresets.fullHint: All layers on GPU, KV follows default (f16) — fastest, most VRAM
